Interview Gym
Practice. Prepare. Perform.

Build Your Skills for Delivering a Knock-Out Interview

Practice answering interview questions on your phone or computer, record your responses, review your delivery, and save your recordings for class assignments or personal practice.

Choose Your Workout

Select the job role you are preparing for. Each role has a 10-question bank; choose whether you want to practice 5, 7, or all 10 questions.

Recording format: Choose 1 question for a quick practice session. Choose 5, 7, or 10 questions to create one continuous interview video for class submission.

Before You Begin

  • Choose a quiet, well-lit location.
  • Position the camera at about eye level.
  • Look toward the camera when answering.
  • Use specific examples whenever possible.
  • Keep most answers focused and concise.

Privacy by Design

This prototype records video locally in your browser. Your recording is not uploaded to a server. You decide whether to download and submit it.

Review Your Answer

Watch your recording, then evaluate your response before deciding whether to keep it or try again.

Did I answer the question directly?
Did I provide a specific example or supporting detail?
Was my answer organized and easy to follow?
Did I sound confident and professional?
Was my answer appropriately concise?
There are no right or wrong answers. The goal is to notice what you did well and what you might improve before a real interview.

Interview Tips

Keep it focused✓

STAR for Behavioral Questions

Situation — Set the context.

Task — Explain what needed to be done.

Action — Explain what you did.

Result — Tell what happened.

Tip: You do not need to say “Situation, Task, Action, Result.” Just tell the story clearly.

Interview Complete

Review your practice session and download your recordings for submission or future practice.

For a class assignment, download the recording and submit it through your instructor's designated course system.

Developed as a prototype for the Collin College Career Center. Interview Gym is a practice and self-review tool; it is not an assessment of employability.
